info.title: Wings personal API
info.description: Authenticated API for the signed-in user's own pages, plus remote MCP at /api/mcp. Human sign-in stays Google or magic link. Agents use a personal access token (Authorization: Bearer) or OAuth 2.1 for MCP clients such as ChatGPT and Claude. The API is owner-only: it does not return another user's pages. Local-vault bodies are omitted.

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token (wings_pat_…) or OAuth access token (wings_oat_…).

200.description: Authorization server metadata. PKCE S256 only.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code or rotate a refresh token

200.description: Short-lived access token and rotated refresh token

post.summary: Revoke an OAuth access or refresh token (RFC 7009)

200.description: Always 200 when the request is well formed

post.summary: Streamable HTTP MCP (JSON-RPC). Tools: list_pages, get_page, search_pages, create_page, update_page, append_to_page.

200.description: JSON-RPC result, or SSE when Accept includes text/event-stream

401.description: WWW-Authenticate points at protected resource metadata

get.summary: List the caller's pages, including parent_id and content_storage. Bodies are omitted.

post.summary: Create a cloud page. Requires the write scope. Optional parent_id.

get.summary: Get one page. Local-vault bodies are omitted with a message.

patch.summary: Update title, parent, or markdown. Requires write. Empty replacement of a substantial page is refused.

post.summary: Append markdown to a cloud page. Requires write.

get.summary: Search the caller's cloud page text and titles. Results are metadata only.
